svg.title: The CPU that isn't what the box says
svg.desc: Schematic comparison of two dies. Left, a retail Intel Core i7-1255U: 2 P-cores and 8 E-cores, 12 threads, 12 MB L3, up to 4.7 GHz. Right, what lscpu reported, Genuine Intel(R) 0000: 4 P-cores and 4 E-cores, 12 threads, 18 MB L3, up to 4.0 GHz. Same thread count, different chip.

g.text: The CPU that isn't what the box says
